messages.author: aa0637f6d7b0f75b
messages.subject: Extraction of spatially varying coefficient coregionalization model to spatiotemporal
parts:
Dear INLA group,

i have been working on svc coregionalization model using inlabru 
using the following codes in inlabru and it worked well:


unfortunately, iam trying to extend the above model to allow s1 and s2 to be spatiotemporal latent fields to analyze a 10 year monthly data once, and beta and intercept to be svc using the following codes:

coordinates(obs.10)<- ~Longitude+Latitude
coords.obs10 <- obs.10@coords
obs.10$obsTemp <- obs.10$TM
obs.10$simTemp <- obs.10$TM_NP
obsTemp <- obs.10$simTemp
month_id <- obs.10$month_id

coordinates(sim.10)<- ~Lon_Np+Lat_Np
coords.sim10 <- sim.10@coords
sim.10$simTemp <- sim.10$TM_NP
simTemp <- sim.10$simTemp

svc.comp.1 <- ~ -1  + intercept(coords.obs10, model = spde)+
  s1( coords.sim10, model = spde, group = month_id, ngroup =120, control.group = list(model='ar1') )+
  s2( coords.obs10, model = spde, group = month_id, ngroup=120, control.group = list(model='ar1')) +
  beta(coords.obs10,model = spde)

formula_1 <- simTemp ~-1 + s1
formula_2 <-  obsTemp ~ -1  + intercept+(beta*s1) + s2

like_1 <- like("gaussian", formula = formula_1, data =sim.10)
like_2 <- like('gaussian', formula = formula_2, data = obs.10)

joint <- bru(svc.comp.1,like_1, like_2,   options = list(
  control.compute = list(waic = TRUE, cpo = TRUE),
  control.family = list(list(hyper=precprior_x),list(hyper=precprior_x)),
  verbose = TRUE))

but i ended up with the error below, any help please:

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Extraction of spatially varying coefficient coregionalization model to spatiotemporal
parts:
I guess you have checked that you have enough RAM to do this? I would
guess this is why it fail.

You would like to use the most recent testing version for R-4.3, which
is better in this wa

you can also add

control.compute=list(save.memory=TRUE)

but that will not go into effect before later in the calculations.


can you run on a larger linux-server?

alternative, if you provide code/data I can rerun, I can check here.

H
